🏦 Rate decision: the Reserve Bank has kept the repo rate at 7.25%.

That means prime stays at 10.75%.

What it means for you (repayments at prime):
🔹 R1 million home loan over 20 years: no change, about R10,152 a month
🔹 R500,000 home loan over 20 years: no change, about R5,076 a month
🔹 R250,000 car loan over 6 years: no change, about R4,727 a month (car loans are often charged above prime)
🔹 Savers: no change

Why: Governor Lesetja Kganyago pointed to risks to inflation, including a rising trend in core inflation. Inflation reached 5.2% in October, well above the 3% target.

General information, not financial advice.
